name: usage-band
description: Shows rate-limit usage, context fill, the current model and a busy/idle dot above the prompt

position.title: Band position
position.description: left / right: above the prompt on that side; below: under the prompt, at the right

showPath.title: Show path
showPath.description: Show the session's folder path on the other side of the band

showCache.title: Show cache
showCache.description: Show the minutes the prompt cache has left (estimated, 1 hour after the last request)

form.title: Band form
form.description: short: numbers only; long: with the Context / Cache labels

notify.title: Notifications
notify.description: Show a Windows notification when an answer finishes or Claude waits for you while another app is in front
